## 1. Loading the file (A1)

- The file escapes quotes with a backslash (`\"`: 3,437,810 times) instead of doubling them (`""`: 67 times).
- A default `pd.read_csv` **fails: ParserError: Error tokenizing data. C error: Expected 593 fields in line 11, saw 647**
- With `escapechar='\\'` it parses into 10,088 rows, one per physical line.

## 2. Fragment rows and broken records (A2, A3)

- 88 rows are not records: their `unique_id` is a piece of text, not an ID. They are pieces of 30 real records whose description contained line breaks.
- All 88 fragments belong to those 30 records. Each record's first line ends right after `description`, and its other **23 columns** sit on its last fragment line.
- **Repaired: 30 of 30.** The description text from the middle lines is re-joined, and the 23 columns come from the last line.

| How the last line was decoded | Records |
|---|---|
| pass1+quote | 28 |
| pass1+quote, pass2+quote, lists re-joined | 2 |
- `pass1+quote`: the last line is normal CSV once the description's opening quote is added back.
- The 2 harder records (*Jayapriya Eye Hospital, Hubli*; *Royals Dental Care, Haldwani*) had their tail escaped twice and their lists split into one field per item. The pieces were re-joined into lists. Their GeoJSON `coordinates` was rebuilt from latitude/longitude.
- Check on every repaired record: specialties parse as a list, source_urls parse as a list, latitude and longitude are numbers, and cluster_id is present.
- Result: 30/30 have specialties, 30/30 have coordinates inside India, 30/30 have source URLs.
- The first, cut-off description is kept in `raw_description_truncated`. Each repaired row has `flag_repaired_record = True`.
- `facilities_quarantine.csv` keeps all 88 fragments, each with the record it belongs to and its original line number.

## 3. Exact duplicates (A4)

- 11 `unique_id`s appear twice. Byte-identical: **True**, so one copy of each was dropped.
- Facilities affected: Chanddni Hospital, Durgapur Sub Divisional Hospital, HCG Multi Specialty Hospital, MOSC Medical College Hospital, Malhotra Super Speciality Hospital, PPK Hospital, Sabine Hospital and Research Centre, Shraddha Heart Hospital, Trustwell Hospitals, Vanni Hospital, Yadgire Super Specialty Hospital.

## 6. Types and categories (A7)

- Numbers: 0 conversion failures for all 11 numeric columns. Doctors, beds and year are whole numbers (nullable integers).
- Dates: only exact `YYYY-MM-DD` values are converted. 11 page-update values and 18 last-post values are text with no reliable date (e.g. '1 month ago', '2 months ago', '2024', '12 February', '13 March', '2 months ago'). They are left missing and kept in `raw_`, so no year is invented.
- `facilityTypeId`: farmacy (10) → pharmacy. Now: {'hospital': 5626, 'clinic': 3782, 'dentist': 490, '<missing>': 57, 'doctor': 21, 'pharmacy': 12, 'nursing_home': 1}.
- `operatorTypeId`: government (2) → public. Now: {'private': 8835, '<missing>': 687, 'public': 467}.

## 7. Specialties (G5, G6)

- Distinct specialty strings: **2,927 → 2,476**. 451 spellings were merged into one version each, changing 824 facility mentions.
- Rule: two strings are the same specialty if they match after ignoring case, spaces and punctuation. The code-style spelling wins (e.g. `cardiology`); otherwise the most common spelling.
- Examples: `Physiotherapy` → `physiotherapy`; `Cardiology` → `cardiology`; `Urology` → `urology`; `oralAndMaxilloFacialSurgery` → `oralAndMaxillofacialSurgery`; `Orthodontics` → `orthodontics`; `Orthopaedics` → `orthopaedics`; `neuroSurgery` → `neurosurgery`; `Neurosurgery` → `neurosurgery`; `Neurology` → `neurology`; `Nephrology` → `nephrology`.
- After cleaning: 2,060 code-style strings and 416 free-text ones (top: `developmental–behavioralPediatrics` (146), `TMJSurgery` (17), `ENT/ Otorhinolaryngologist` (8), `orth orthopedicSurgery` (7), `Obstetrics & Gynaecology` (6), `IVF` (5)).
- `internalMedicine` is on **68.6%** of facilities. `specialties_informative` = the specialty list without it.
- 1,579 specialties are used by only one facility. They are **kept** and listed in `specialties_rare`, because many are meaningful (e.g. `ABO-i Kidney Transplant`, `AV Fistula creation for dialysis`, `Abbe Flap Ca Lip`, `Accident & Trauma`, `Acne Scar Treatment`).

## 12. Verification against real outside data

Sources: **India Post PIN directory** (official, in the repo); **Wikidata** (independent, downloaded 21 Nov 2026: 3,105 Indian hospitals and medical schools, 704 with a founding date, 106 with a bed count, 611 with an English Wikipedia article); **web search** for the extreme values; and the facility's **own text** (the same source, so it only shows consistency).

### 12a. Matching facilities to Wikidata

| Match rule | Facilities |
|---|---|
| official website + name + location (<=15 km) | 150 |
| name + location (<=5 km) | 130 |
| name + location (<=15 km) | 5 |

- **285 facilities matched** (median distance 0.13 km). 17 weaker second claims on the same Wikidata item were dropped.
- Rules: name similarity (generic words, state names and the facility's own city removed; a specialty-word mismatch such as Dental vs not is penalised) AND within 15 km of the record's coordinates or its PIN centre. The record's own `officialWebsite` domain can lower the name threshold.
- **Manual audit:** about 310 matches in 7 random samples were reviewed by eye while building the rules. Each error found led to a rule change. With the final rules, a general sample of 50 was 50/50 correct and a sample of 30 medical-school matches was 29/30 (the miss: SVIMS Tirupati matched to Sri Venkateswara Medical College). Four matches found wrong or doubtful in the audit are rejected in the code (`REJECTED_MATCHES`): Krishna Clinic → Krishna Heart Institute, Regional Mental Hospital Nagpur → Yerwada Mental Hospital, SVIMS Tirupati → Sri Venkateswara Medical College, Max Centre for Liver & Biliary Sciences → ILBS.

| verified | 6,378 |
| conflict | 1,470 |
| consistent | 1,145 |

| partly verified (Wikidata location only) | 6 |

- PIN found in India Post: 9,700. The city appears in the PIN's district or post-office names: 8,420; it does not: 1,280.
- **verified** = valid PIN, state agrees, coordinates within 10 km of the PIN centre, and the city matches the PIN (or Wikidata confirms the location). **consistent** = within 25 km. **conflict** = state contradicts the PIN (excluding the AP/Telangana split) or coordinates more than 100 km from the PIN.
- Limit: this checks that the PIN, city, state and coordinates agree with official data. It cannot confirm the street or building.

### 12f. Using real values instead of the dataset's (`<col>_source`, `<col>_alt_value`)
Rules (the dataset's value always stays in `raw_<col>`):
1. **Web check with a specific value** → it replaces the record value.
2. **Record has no value, Wikidata has one** → filled from Wikidata.
3. **Record and Wikidata disagree, not web-checked** → the record value stays, Wikidata's value goes in `<col>_alt_value`, and the check says *disputed*.
Rule 3 exists because of the web checks themselves. Of 8 year disagreements checked on the web, Wikidata was right in 1 (MIOT), the record in 3 (RIMS 1960, Goa Medical College 1842, Mohak 2010), neither in 2 (Oyster & Pearl → 2008, IMS & SUM → 2007) and 2 are unresolved. Wikidata's 'inception' is sometimes a renaming or upgrade date, so copying it blindly would add new errors.

- **Replaced after a web check: 4** · **filled from Wikidata: 28** · **disputed (both values shown): 36** ({'yearEstablished': 24, 'capacity': 12})

| Field | Facility | Record value | Real value | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yearEstablished | Sum Hospital | 1978 | 2007 | web check |
| yearEstablished | Oyster & Pearl Prime Hospital | 1960 | 2008 | web check |
| yearEstablished | MIOT International | 1987 | 1999 | web check |
| capacity | Wockhardt Hospital | 1600 | 118 | web check |

All fills and disputes are listed in `value_corrections.csv` and `value_disputes.csv`.

### 12g. Recognition (`recognition_tier`, `recognition_score`, `recognition_evidence`)
This is **not** a quality or patient-review score: no lawful, free review source covers 10,000 Indian facilities. It counts verifiable signs of standing:

| Signal | Points |
|---|---|
| English Wikipedia article (via Wikidata match) | +3 |
| Listed on Wikidata only | +1 |
| NABH / JCI accreditation claimed in the record | +2 |
| NABH entry-level / pre-accreditation or NABL claimed | +1 |
| Teaching hospital / medical college / academic affiliation | +2 |
| Operating ≥ 50 years (year confirmed or consistent) | +2 |
| Operating 25–49 years | +1 |

Tiers: high ≥ 5, moderate 3–4, some 1–2, *no evidence found* 0. *No evidence found* means **unknown**, not bad.

| recognition_tier | Facilities |
|---|---|
| no evidence found | 7,203 |
| some | 2,185 |
| moderate | 435 |
| high | 166 |
